license.description: License is the verified claims of the Cluster's currently set License. It is unset when the Cluster does not have a License set.

state.title: State
state.description: State is the current state of the Cluster's License.

setAt.description: SetAt is the date at which the License was set.

GetLicenseResponse.title: Get License Response
GetLicenseResponse.description: GetLicenseResponse is the response of the GetLicense method.

version.description: Version is the version of the License format.

uid.description: UID is the unique identifier of the License.

organization.description: Organization is the organization that the License was issued to.

issuedAt.description: IssuedAt is the date at which the License was issued.

notBefore.description: NotBefore is the date starting from which the License is valid.

notAfter.description: NotAfter is the expiry date of the License.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the type of the License.

allowedClusterDomains.description: AllowedClusterDomains is the list of the Cluster domains that the License is valid for. An empty list means that the License is valid for every Cluster domain.

plan.description: Plan is the commercial plan that the License was issued for. It is unset for Licenses that were issued before plans were introduced.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.License.title: License
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.License.description: License is the commercial License that entitles the Cluster to use the enterprise features. It is issued by Octelium Labs as a signed JWT which is supplied to the Cluster via the SetLicense method. The fields below are the verified claims of that JWT.

uid.description: UID is the unique identifier of the organization.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the human-readable name of the organization.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.License..title: Organization
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.License..description: Organization is the organization that the License was issued to

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the type of the plan.

tier.description: Tier is the identifier of the pricing tier of the plan (e.g. "T1"). Tiers are defined by the Octelium Labs commercial catalog and typically correspond to the size of the organization.

support.description: Support is the support level that is included in the plan.

limits.description: Limits are the usage limits of the plan.

features.description: Features is the list of the optional add-on features that are included in the plan.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.License..title: Plan
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.License..description: Plan is the commercial plan that the License was issued for.

maxUsers.description: MaxUsers is the maximum number of the Users that the plan covers. A zero value means that the number of Users is not limited.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.License..title: Limits
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.License..description: Limits are the usage limits of the plan.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the type of the support level.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.License..title: Support
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.License..description: Support is the support level that is included in the plan.
